brief:
Jared Kushner, former senior adviser to Donald Trump, stated that the ongoing war presents an opportunity for Gaza's development, according to Middle East Eye. His comments framed the conflict as a potential catalyst for rebuilding efforts in the territory.

The remarks come as Gaza faces widespread destruction from military operations. Kushner's statement reflects a perspective that links the conflict to future economic and infrastructure projects in the enclave.
title: Kushner sees Gaza reconstruction as opportunity amid conflict
